classification.difficultyReason: Plan several linked deductions without named intermediate unknowns: transfer angles along the marked parallel lines, combine or supplement sectors, and select the straight-angle or revolution total that isolates the marked angle.

content.prompt: Find the size of the marked angle $\angle POQ$ in each diagram below. Several steps may be required.

spec.description: Upper and lower V figures joined by three vertical parallel segments. Matching triple arrow marks identify PA, ON and QB.
spec.mathematics: PA parallel to ON parallel to QB; angle APO=55 degrees; angle OQB=45 degrees; upper angle POQ marked.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens and an unlabelled target arc only.

answer.worked:
$\angle PON=125^\circ$ (co-interior angles, $PA\parallel ON$).

$\angle QON=135^\circ$ (co-interior angles, $QB\parallel ON$).

$$\begin{align*}\angle POQ&=360^\circ-125^\circ-135^\circ\\\angle POQ&=100^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles in a revolution at $O$.

spec.description: P, O, N and M lie on one horizontal line. OQ and NR have matching parallel arrows. Both supplied angles at N are retained.
spec.mathematics: OQ parallel to NR; angle MNR=64 degrees; angle RNQ=34 degrees; obtuse angle POQ marked below the horizontal.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens and target arc only; retain the redundant 34-degree measurement.

answer.worked:
$\angle NOQ=64^\circ$ (corresponding angles, $OQ\parallel NR$).

$$\begin{align*}\angle POQ&=180^\circ-64^\circ\\\angle POQ&=116^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on the straight line $PON$.

spec.description: Triangle POQ with PO parallel to FQG, OQR collinear and a horizontal extension of PQ beyond Q. The two separate angles to the extension remain visible.
spec.mathematics: PO parallel to FQG; angle between QG and the rightward extension of PQ is 15 degrees; angle between that extension and QR is 32 degrees; angle POQ marked.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and target arc.

answer.worked:
$\angle GQR=15^\circ+32^\circ=47^\circ$ (adjacent angles).

$\angle OQG=180^\circ-47^\circ=133^\circ$ (angles on the straight line $OQR$).

$\angle POQ=133^\circ$ (alternate angles, $PO\parallel QG$).

spec.description: Three parallel horizontal segments XP, OY and ZQ, with P above-left and Q below-left of O. The left-hand angle at O is marked.
spec.mathematics: XP parallel to OY parallel to ZQ; angle XPO=155 degrees; angle ZQO=142 degrees; left-hand angle POQ required.
spec.answerVisibility: Given angles and unlabelled target arc only.

answer.worked:
$\angle POY=155^\circ$ (alternate angles, $XP\parallel OY$).

$\angle QOY=142^\circ$ (alternate angles, $ZQ\parallel OY$).

$$\begin{align*}\angle POQ&=360^\circ-155^\circ-142^\circ\\\angle POQ&=63^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles in a revolution at $O$.
